properties.description: compare_designs reads the `reflow2_version` each side's stamp already carries and, when they differ, says so in its result alongside the finding counts — naming build skew as a possible cause of property-only differences without suppressing, reweighting or hiding any of them. The reader is told what could confound the reading; nothing decides on their behalf.
properties.name: A comparison discloses that its two sides came from different builds
